recognize_zh: 周邊血中大量圓形細胞，胞質充滿粗大深紫黑色的嗜鹼性顆粒並遮蓋細胞核，部分細胞顆粒較少可見細緻染色質；與中上方正常的帶狀中性球相比，這些異常嗜鹼性細胞明顯增加，符合急性嗜鹼性白血病。
features: Increased numbers of round cells packed with coarse dark purple-black basophilic granules obscuring nuclear detail
Some cells with less densely packed granules revealing round nuclei with finer chromatin (immature forms)
Cells slightly larger than red cells, with little visible agranular cytoplasm
Band neutrophil with fine pale granules at upper center for comparison
Red cells with rouleaux-like stacking and a scattered platelet
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous round cells containing coarse, dark purple-black basophilic granules that obscure the nucleus, with some less granular forms showing round nuclei with finer chromatin. A band neutrophil is present for comparison, and red cells show rouleaux-like stacking. Blasts without granules are not clearly identified in this field. Findings are consistent with acute basophilic leukemia in the appropriate clinical and immunophenotypic context; CML and other BCR::ABL1-positive or t(6;9) leukemias with basophilia must be excluded.

ddx.vs: Mature basophils in CML or reactive states have segmented nuclei and occur with a full granulocytic left shift, and CML is BCR::ABL1-positive.
Mast cells are larger with oval eccentric nuclei and CD117/tryptase positivity, with KIT D816V mutation.
Toxic granulation shows dark granules in neutrophils with segmented nuclei and pink background cytoplasm, not granules obscuring a round nucleus.
